source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The controller records accountHubLoaded with the requested flow before awaiting that flow. Email #initUI records its subview before template loading and visibility updates. Reset passes isReset=true, which suppresses the reset-only visit. These events describe entry attempts and repeated navigation; they do not prove completed loading, authentication or account creation. The owned test expected eight events, while the fixed accepted test expects seven in its later navigation scenario. Keep those source phases separate.
title: Account Hub loaded events record view entry before async setup completes
